name: DeltaKV: Residual-Based KV Cache Compression via Long-Range Similarity.
description: DeltaKV: Residual-Based KV Cache Compression via Long-Range Similarity.  Encodes semantic residuals relative to retrieved historical references, preserving attention fidelity while drastically compressing dynamic KV caches.  Paper: "DeltaKV: Residual-Based KV Cache Compression via Long-Range Similarity"        Hao et al., arXiv:2602.08005. Registered as 'delta_kv'.
math_latex: R_K \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times H \times 1 \times M \times D}, \quad R_V \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times H \times 1 \times M \times D}

components.name: Latent KV Compression Projection
components.math_latex: c^{KV}_t = W^{DKV} x_t, \quad c^{KV}_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d_c}, \; d_c \ll d_{in}

components.name: Key Dequantize / Unpack
components.math_latex: k^C_t = W^{UK} c^{KV}_t, \quad W^{UK} \in \mathbb{R}^{n_h d_h \times d_c}

components.name: Value Dequantize / Unpack
components.math_latex: v^C_t = W^{UV} c^{KV}_t, \quad W^{UV} \in \mathbb{R}^{n_h d_h \times d_c}
